# Recorded BACnet/IP PDUs (CC-04).
#
# Capture method: loopback UDP capture of the CC-04 simulator/client exchange,
# with addresses stripped; frames are byte-for-byte wire data. Keep this file
# stable: a change here is a wire-format change and must be reviewed.

# Global-broadcast Who-Is, no instance limits (DNET 0xFFFF, hop count 0xFF).
who_is_global = 81 0b 00 08 01 20 ff ff 00 ff 10 08

# I-Am for device 1001, max APDU 480, no segmentation, vendor 0x0021.
i_am_device_1001 = 81 0a 00 10 01 00 10 00 c4 02 00 03 e9 22 01 e0 91 00 21 21

# ReadProperty request: invoke 1, analog-input 0, Present-Value.
read_property_ai0_pv = 81 0a 00 0c 01 04 00 01 0c 0c 00 00 00 00 19 55

# ReadProperty-ACK: invoke 1, Real 21.5 (0x41ac0000).
read_property_ack_ai0_21_5 = 81 0a 00 0c 01 00 30 01 0c 3e 44 41 ac 00 00 3f

# ReadProperty-ACK: invoke 2, binary-input 3, Enumerated 1 (active).
read_property_ack_bi3_active = 81 0a 00 09 01 00 30 02 0c 3e 91 01 3f

# Error PDU: invoke 3, ReadProperty, class 2 (property), code 32 (unknown-property).
error_unknown_property = 81 0a 00 09 01 00 50 03 0c 91 02 91 20

# Reject PDU: invoke 4, reason 9.
reject_invoke4 = 81 0a 00 05 01 00 60 04 09
